canonical_data: the workspace tree and Git state, AGENTS.md instructions, task lists, conversation history, local project memory, and edit history, plus the GLM Coding Plan account that meters model usage
current_repo_note: The ZCode desktop client is proprietary with no operational source repository; the official zai-org/zcode-plugins repository publishes the plugin marketplace under Apache-2.0 but is not the product, so this record carries no repository and imports none of its star count.
strengths: A single long-horizon task keeps goals, file references, terminal results, browser context, execution modes, and Git state in one context, with Goal Mode adding completion verification and state recovery for sustained work.

Execution control is a designed surface rather than an afterthought: four modes from ask-before-every-change (the default) through plan-first and full access, plus built-in safety confirmation for sensitive commands and file operations.
The same task can be followed and advanced from the desktop, a mobile remote surface, or Feishu and WeChat bots, and idle-time tasks run during spare capacity without consuming plan quota.

Interoperability follows real conventions: AGENTS.md project instructions, one-time CLAUDE.md migration, MCP server support, custom Anthropic- and OpenAI-compatible providers, and a plugin and skill system.
weaknesses: The model line is the differentiator and the lock-in: deep GLM-5.3 integration is the headline, the Coding Plan metering runs through Z.ai or BigModel server-side quotas, and there is no documented rollback path for filesystem changes beyond the edit-history surface.
The product is young (GLM-5.2 era launch in mid-2026, now at 3.12.x) and its ecosystem and independent adoption evidence are thin; vendor-run claims dominate public discussion.

Model choice outside the first-party path still depends on user-configured keys and the coding-only endpoint split between Coding Plan and general API access, which the documentation itself warns is easy to misconfigure.
Terms restrict use to non-commercial personal research unless a paid plan is active, and the client requires elevated local system privileges with the vendor recommending an isolated environment.
why_it_matters: The clearest worked example of a vendor's own desktop harness tuned to its flagship open-weights model line, showing how GLM-5.3's long-context, long-horizon capabilities are packaged into a product with its own agent workflow, execution modes, and multi-surface control.
